title: PAR-intercalated Mg/Al layered double hydroxide for efficient adsorption of acid fuchsin: experimental study and molecular docking insights
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,6408-6420
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08890A, Paper

Sara E. Abdel Hameed, Weam M. Abou El-Maaty, Esam A. Gomaa, Fathi S. Awad
This study systematically investigated the adsorptive removal of acid fuchsin (AF), an anionic dye, from aqueous solutions using a 4-(2-pyridylazo)resorcinol-intercalated magnesium/aluminum layered double hydroxide (PAR-Mg/Al LDH).
